name: Garlic Pork Chops with Rice and Peas
summary: Pan-seared boneless pork chops finished in garlic butter, with rice and peas. One pan plus a pot of rice.
instructions: Start the rice: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes. Stir in the frozen peas, cover, and let it sit off the heat for 5 minutes.
Pat the chops dry and season both sides with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chops 4–5 minutes per side until browned and 145°F (63°C) inside.
Turn the heat to low. Add the butter and garlic and spoon the melted butter over the chops for 1 minute.
Rest the chops 3 minutes, then serve with the rice and peas and the pan butter poured over everything.

glutenFree.notes: Pork, rice, peas, butter, and spices are naturally gluten-free.

budgetNotes: Club-pack boneless chops at $13.23/kg are the cheap way to buy them. Freeze what you don't use in pairs.
Bone-in chops are often cheaper on sale and work the same way. Add 1–2 minutes per side.
Don't move the chops while they sear. That is what browns them.
